implementation_contract: Restore _code_payload to the exact pre-optimization fresh dict/list construction behavior. Do not route it through cache reads, JSON decode or thawing. Existing callers other than _function_sha256 retain their original path.

Cache only immutable canonical JSON bytes representing the code field, used exclusively by _function_sha256. The code-only producer obtains those bytes from the original code payload semantics and exact current CodeType; callers must not inject arbitrary encoded payloads.

Use exact CodeType identity, not structural equality. Retain and compare the exact code object to prevent id reuse. Recursively safe immutable primitive/bytes/tuple/nested-CodeType constants may be cached; custom or mutable constants use the original uncached fingerprint path.

Preserve signed-zero, bool/int and existing nonfinite normalization, Unicode/escaping and nested code semantics. Each cached code fragment must be byte-identical to the existing canonical encoder output for that original code payload.

On every _function_sha256 call, retain original exact type validation and read current __code__, __module__, __qualname__, __defaults__ and __kwdefaults__. Normalize the latter fields through the original logic and freshly JSON-encode defaults, kwdefaults, module, qualname and schema_version. Assemble only this fixed six-field outer object with code first, then defaults, kwdefaults, module, qualname, schema_version, using exactly the existing canonical ordering, separators, encoding and error behavior before SHA256. No generic JSON fragment API, textual replacement in arbitrary JSON, stale mutable-field cache or nested digest substitution.

Remove the JSON.loads/fresh_payload cache path and its now-unused pins. Keep new helper code/default/module and applicable closure identity sealed through the existing pin mechanism. No generic recursive pin framework.

Reuse the bounded cache and identical immutable-entry mirror under one lock; insert/validate/evict/clear both consistently. Require matching membership and exact entry identity plus exact code/bytes/size. Preserve code-only producer provenance and fail closed on one-sided or mismatched state, without silently repairing cache corruption.

Keep 128-entry and 4-MiB retained canonical representation-byte bounds, oversized bypass and transparent eviction/concurrency behavior. The representation limit is not a total-RSS guarantee; no unbounded second payload store.

Do not cache validation PASS, full function fingerprints by function identity, globals, closures, defaults, class/instance behavior, source authority or retained graph validity. Existing live dependency/global/closure checks and source temporal/lifetime semantics remain mandatory.
